messages:
Ravi (Eng Manager): Quick Q — Elena is finishing probation and we want to promote her mid-cycle from IC1 -> IC2 while she's on parental leave (US). Can we set effective date during leave and any payroll/benefits caveats?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats to Elena! :tada: Short: you can set effective_date while on leave, but payroll, benefits, and leave pay interact. Need: promotion justification, probation completion note, effective_date, salary, and whether you want retro pay.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Effective_date = 2026-03-20 (during leave). Base from $95k -> $105k. Want retro to her return date if approved.
Sofia (Compensation): 10.5% increase — triggers comp committee review. Attach market bench and probation docs. For retro pay: payroll can issue retro pay for the period between effective_date and first payroll after approval.
Marta (Finance): For parental leave (US FMLA-like), leave pay is calculated on base at time leave started unless company policy states otherwise. If promotion effective during leave, we need to check whether leave pay should be adjusted retroactively — legal team sometimes prefers no retro adjustments to leave pay; we need HR legal confirm.
Priya (People Ops): Action items: 1) submit leveling packet marking "probation complete" and attach manager signoff, 2) flag "on_leave" in form, 3) request legal review for leave pay interaction, 4) choose retro option (yes/no).
Ravi (Eng Manager): Submitted packet, attached signed probation completion and manager justification. Marked retro_yes but noted contingent on legal.
PeopleOpsBot: Promotion/comp packet: https://redwood.company/hr/leveling_packet — set fields: effective_date, on_leave=true, retro_request=true.
Sofia (Compensation): Routing to comp committee. If legal ok and comp committee approves, we can instruct payroll to issue a retro adjustment. Note: retro pay will be taxed in payment period and may not change historical leave payments without legal ok.
Marta (Finance): I'll loop in Legal and Finance ops. Off-cycle retro payroll is possible but needs cost center approval.
Priya (People Ops): Keep communications: do NOT tell Elena specifics beyond "promotion under review; timeline ~3-7 business days" until legal + comp committee finish.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Understood. Ping me when legal responds.
Sofia (Compensation): Comp committee approved the increase pending legal signoff on leave-pay treatment.
Marta (Finance): Legal says leave pay stands on original base; promotion can be effective during leave but retro base pay is paid going forward — we cannot recalc historical leave pay. So retro pay only covers non-leave pay periods after approval.
Priya (People Ops): Final steps: People Ops will issue promotion confirmation and updated comp letter. Payroll will process retro adjustment for eligible pay and schedule any off-cycle if needed (with Finance signoff). Closing thread once docs sent. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone — will update Elena as "approved pending paperwork" per guidance.
